name: The Coast Isn't Clear
summary: Along Westfall's western shore, shipwrecked sailors face murloc tribes on the beaches. Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse calls for help clearing the coast so survivors can reach land safely.

sections.title: A Graveyard of Ships
sections.body: Westfall's western coast has claimed countless ships. Reefs, sudden squalls, and jagged rocks break vessels against the shoals. Survivors may cling to wreckage and crawl ashore, hoping for rescue. But murloc tribes control the beaches and show no mercy to castaways.

sections.title: The Ghostly Lookout
sections.body: Captain Grayson tends the Westfall Lighthouse from a lonely outcropping southwest of the mainland. Death has bound him to the post, yet he remains watchful over passing ships and sailors in need. Murlocs make the shore deadly, from Coastrunners in the north to Tidehunters, Warriors, and Oracles in the south. Grayson calls on travelers to clear the coastline.

faq.answer: Captain Grayson is the spectral sea captain who haunts the Westfall Lighthouse. He still feels bound to protect sailors navigating the dangerous waters and those who survive a wreck.

faq.q: Why does Grayson want the murlocs cleared from the coast?
faq.answer: Grayson wants the murlocs cleared because shipwrecked sailors often wash ashore along Westfall. Murlocs swarm the beaches from north to south and kill survivors who reach land.

faq.q: Where are these different murlocs located?
faq.answer: Murloc Coastrunners generally live along the northern Westfall coast. Murloc Warriors, Oracles, and Tidehunters gather in settlements and camps on the southern beaches.

faq.q: Is Captain Grayson hostile to the Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: Captain Grayson is neutral. His duty to sailors crosses political lines, and he asks any capable traveler to help make the coast safer.

faq.q: Does this quest require relighting the lighthouse first?
aliases: do i need keeper of the flame first
faq.answer: No. Captain Grayson asks you to clear the coast whether or not you have helped relight the Westfall Lighthouse.

faq.q: Are the murlocs working for the Defias Brotherhood?
faq.answer: No. The murlocs act on their own and attack anyone entering their shoreline hunting grounds. The Defias Brotherhood operates nearby, in the Moonbrook region and southern coves.

angles.text: With the Stormwind army absent from Westfall, the People's Militia struggles to protect inland farms. Coastal defense falls to allies such as Captain Grayson.
As a human, you know merchant vessels and fishermen have long sailed Westfall's waters. The murloc-held shore is a bitter sign of the kingdom's lost frontiers.
